notes: Catalog parts only (UIC/literature integrated inductors such as Shared_Core_UIC_250_nH excluded). Electrical data parsed with pdftotext from vendor datasheets (Coilcraft getmedia PDFs, Eaton/TDK/Bourns PDFs, Wurth per-part PDFs). Isat_A uses the 30% drop value for composite/metal parts (Coilcraft XEL/XGL, Wurth, TDK CLT32/SPM) and the 20% drop value for ferrite parts (Coilcraft SLC/SLR, Eaton, TDK VLB, Bourns); all available drop levels are in Isat_by_drop_A. Irms_A is the 40 C (or 40 K) rise rating in every case; vendors differ in PCB/test conditions. DCR_max is derived (nominal x (1+tol)) where the datasheet gives only nominal +/- tolerance; see DCR_note. Prices: unit price at the 1,000-piece column as listed on Octopart search pages on 2026-11-25 (Coilcraft Direct for Coilcraft; else Mouser, then other authorized distributors); MOQ/packaging in price_note. Coilcraft, Digi-Key and Mouser sites blocked scripted access, so Octopart aggregation was used. Eaton K-factor chart data were digitized from PDF vector paths (FP1308/FP1308R/FP1007R6/FP1107) or raster pixels (TL1011V2). Eaton old-style FP1308 (DS4313) is not recommended for new designs; FP1308R3 used. FP0705 (7x7x4.95 mm, 72-226 nH, raster loss chart) and FP1007R3 exist but were not included. TDK SPM5030-HZ starts at 0.47 uH/11 A and was not included.
